items.title: Genevieve Rose interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: Mostly I listened to the classical guitar music, Segovia, and those.

ctx.x: ‘76. So the music that you were listening to as you grew up was what? What was going on in your household?

Well I listened a lot to the oldies, ‘50s and ‘60s type of music. There is a radio station around my area, it’s called Big D 103, and so I would always listen to that all the time. My brother listened to a lot of the current music but I never really did. I mostly enjoyed the oldies. And I think, well I got involved with music pretty early, I was eight years old, and I started with the guitar at the same time my brother started piano lessons. And so really before that I wasn’t really concerned too much with…
So you didn’t really know who it was.
